crop.notes: Excerpt (three paragraphs) from the longer article 'As to Tommy White: The Matchmaker of the Commercial Club Did Not Know Him'. The headline is not in the clipping, but the whole Allen passage is.

title.suggested: Allen at the Champion's Rest Named Among Ring Veterans

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch, mocking a Chicago matchmaker who did not know Tommy White, said Tom Allen at the Champion's Rest could tell the history of the prize ring in the new and old country.

metadata.notes: Masthead: Wednesday, St. Louis Post-Dispatch, November 16, 1898, page 5.

facts.fact: Allen was at his saloon, the Champion's Rest, in St. Louis, around the corner from Tom Kelly's

notes: Wording is loose; the passage compares Allen, Kelly and Jack Looney with old Chicago fighters Bussey and Duffy.
